# UE5 HTML5 Exporter v0.3.49

This release brings Blueprint-inferred Discord access requirements into Unreal itself.

- Export and local Discord preview dialogs now name the optional Discord features detected from the exported Blueprint graph.
- Unreal shows the exact required authorization: `identify only` by default, adding `rpc.activities.write` only when Rich Presence nodes require it.
- The dialog explains when the release assistant will configure Rich Presence automatically.
- Unreal states the privacy boundary before handoff: no client secret, bot token, email, billing information, or Discord player profile is written into the export.
- The export commandlet prints the same feature, authorization, and privacy evidence for Windows workstation automation.
- Manifest, handoff, UI, and commandlet reporting use one computed requirements result, preventing a separate human-readable checklist from drifting from enforced release preflight.

The browser runtime and export schemas remain compatible with v0.3.48. Native Win64 compilation on a real Windows UE 5.8 workstation and a live two-account Discord Activity run remain final external certification steps.
